title: Hammer Curl
summary: A curl with your palms facing each other, for the brachialis, the forearm and the biceps.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.8 for biceps (main mover): each working set adds 0.8 of a set to the weekly biceps total.
Library rating 0.8 for forearms (main mover): each working set adds 0.8 of a set to the weekly forearms total.

setup.text: Hold the dumbbells at your sides with your palms facing in.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the weights up, keeping the neutral grip.

form_cues.cue: Keep your wrists straight and in line with your forearms.

mistakes.text: Swinging the dumbbells across the body.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less brachialis & brachioradialis bias, Palms-up or palms-down grip.
Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Biceps long-head stretch, Less brachialis & brachioradialis bias.
Swap sheet: Better isolation, More stable, Steadier cable tension.
Swap sheet: Less brachialis & brachioradialis bias, Peak-contraction focus, Better isolation.
